title: Imaging-based biological age gap and risk of mortality and incident diseases: a systematic review and meta-analysis
zh_title: 影像生物学年龄差与死亡及发病风险的系统综述与荟萃分析
summary: 汇总40篇报告（其中21篇纳入荟萃分析），发现影像年龄差每增加5年，全因死亡风险升高（HR 1.31），且与痴呆、卒中、心衰等相关。
key_points: 纳入40篇报告，21篇进入荟萃分析
影像年龄差每增5年，全因死亡HR 1.31（95%CI 1.19–1.44）
与痴呆、卒中、心衰、糖尿病、高血压发病相关；与帕金森病无关
reason: 系统综述与荟萃分析纳入40篇报告，以死亡与发病结局为终点，属重要档；但异质性极高（I²=96.3%）限制证据强度
abstract: Artificial intelligence-derived imaging ageing clocks enable estimation of biological ageing from medical images. Yet meta-analytic quantification of the associations between imaging age gaps and both mortality and incident age-related diseases across multiple organs remains lacking. This study synthesised 40 eligible reports, of which 21 contributed to the meta-analysis. Meta-analyses showed that each 5-year increase in imaging age gap was associated with a higher hazard of all-cause mortality (HR 1.31, 95% CI 1.19–1.44), although heterogeneity was substantial ( I ² = 96.3%), with organ type and sample size contributing to heterogeneity. For cancer-specific mortality, the pooled HR was 1.06 (95% CI 0.96–1.18). Higher imaging age gaps were associated with incident dementia, stroke, heart failure, diabetes and hypertension, but not Parkinson’s disease. Imaging age gaps may support non-invasive risk stratification and long-term health management, but clinical translation requires standardisation, diverse external validation, interpretability, and evidence of clinical utility and equity.
zh_abstract: 人工智能衍生的影像衰老时钟使人们能够从医学图像估计生物学衰老。然而，关于影像年龄差与死亡以及多个器官新发年龄相关疾病之间关联的荟萃分析定量仍然缺乏。本研究综合了40份符合条件报告，其中21份纳入荟萃分析。荟萃分析显示，影像年龄差每增加5年与更高的全因死亡风险相关（HR 1.31，95% CI 1.19–1.44），尽管异质性很大（I²=96.3%），器官类型和样本量对异质性有贡献。对于癌症特异性死亡，合并HR为1.06（95% CI 0.96–1.18）。较高的影像年龄差与新发痴呆、卒中、心力衰竭、糖尿病和高血压相关，但与帕金森病无关。影像年龄差可能支持无创风险分层和长期健康管理，但临床转化需要标准化、多样化的外部验证、可解释性，以及临床效用和公平性证据。

title: Physician AI disclosure, condition severity, and public trust in digital medicine
zh_title: 医生AI披露、病情严重程度与公众对数字医疗的信任
summary: 中国1574名成人5×2析因实验显示，行政类AI评价优于诊断与治疗类AI，高严重度下治疗类AI负面反应更强。
key_points: 5×2析因实验，随机分配1574名中国成人
行政类AI评价优于诊断与治疗类AI
高严重度放大对治疗类AI的负面反应
reason: 前瞻性随机析因实验、样本1574，但非临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: Public trust is central to the implementation of artificial intelligence (AI) in digital medicine, yet little is known about how patients respond to different forms of physician AI disclosure across clinical risk contexts. In a 5 × 2 factorial experiment in mainland China, 1574 adults were randomly assigned to physician profiles varying by AI use type and condition severity. Administrative AI was rated more favorably than diagnostic and therapeutic AI across physician perception and care-seeking intention outcomes. High-severity conditions amplified negative responses to therapeutic AI, whereas explicit non-AI disclosure was associated with greater appointment willingness under high severity. Exploratory mediation analyses suggested that competence, trust, and empathy accounted for different disclosure-related response patterns. Main effects were directionally consistent in a supplementary offline community sample from Macao ( n = 128). These findings suggest that AI disclosure in digital medicine should distinguish administrative from clinical uses and be calibrated to clinical severity, while highlighting the need for preregistered replication using behavioral outcomes.
zh_abstract: 公众信任对于人工智能（AI）在数字医学中的实施至关重要，但患者在不同临床风险情境下如何回应不同形式的医师AI披露，仍知之甚少。在中国大陆开展的一项5 × 2析因实验中，1574名成年人被随机分配到因AI使用类型和病情严重程度而不同的医师档案中。在医师感知和就医意向结局上，行政性AI的评分比诊断性AI和治疗性AI更有利。高严重程度病情放大了对治疗性AI的负面反应，而在高严重程度下，明确非AI披露与更高的预约意愿相关。探索性中介分析提示，能力、信任和共情解释了不同的披露相关反应模式。在来自澳门的一个补充离线社区样本（n = 128）中，主效应的方向一致。这些发现表明，数字医学中的AI披露应区分行政用途与临床用途，并应根据临床严重程度进行校准，同时强调需要使用行为结局进行预注册重复研究。

zh_title: 医学图像分析中的性能不确定性：置信区间大规模考察

title: The proposed reform of the Medical Device Regulation and its implications for AI-enabled medical devices in the EU
zh_title: 欧盟医疗器械法规改革提案对 AI 医疗器械的影响
summary: 评论文章分析欧盟委员会 2025 年 12 月提出的器械法规修订，认为其方向合理，但未解决 AI 器械的特定挑战。
key_points: 欧委会 2025 年 12 月提出关键法规修订
改革旨在消除重复监管、减少文档要求
作者认为 AI 器械的特殊难题仍未解决
reason: 监管政策评述，涉及实际立法提案，但为评论文章，按综述上限取中档
abstract: The European Medical Device Regulations have been criticized for imposing disproportionate barriers to innovation due to excessive regulatory requirements. In response, the European Commission proposed amendments to key regulations in December 2025. The reforms aim to eliminate double regulation, reduce documentation requirements, and introduce new regulatory tools. In this Comment, we argue that these changes are generally well-targeted but leave specific challenges for innovative artificial intelligence-enabled medical devices unresolved.
zh_abstract: 欧洲医疗器械法规（European Medical Device Regulations）因过度监管要求对创新造成不成比例的障碍而受到批评。作为回应，欧盟委员会于2025年12月提出了对关键法规的修订。这些改革旨在消除双重监管、减少文件要求，并引入新的监管工具。在本评论中，我们认为这些变化总体上目标明确，但未解决创新型人工智能赋能医疗器械面临的具体挑战。

title: TabBioMed: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Biomedical Tabular Learning
zh_title: TabBioMed：大规模生物医学表格学习基准
summary: 构建覆盖电子病历、药物发现、基因组与多组学等 94 个公开表格数据集的统一预处理与评测基准，比较 23 个模型。
key_points: 整合 94 个公开生物医学表格数据集，统一预处理与评测流程
覆盖 EHR、药物发现、基因组、转录组、蛋白组、代谢组与单细胞
基准测试 23 个模型，表格基础模型整体表现最强
reason: 大规模公开基准（含 94 个数据集）且系统对比多类模型，达到重要档；预印本不高于 8 分。
abstract: Recent advances in machine learning have accelerated biomedical prediction, but evaluation on structured biomedical data remains fragmented, especially for datasets with high dimensionality, large sample size, missingness, and class imbalance. We introduce TabBioMed, a large-scale benchmark of 94 curated public biomedical tabular datasets spanning electronic health records, drug discovery, genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, single-cell omics, and systems biology. TabBioMed unifies these datasets through a standardized, dataset-aware preprocessing and evaluation framework, enabling reproducible comparison across classification, regression, and multi-target tasks. We benchmark 23 models across classical baselines, gradient-boosted trees, neural tabular architectures, and tabular foundation models. Foundation models deliver the strongest family-level predictive performance. However, their gains are regime-dependent: tree-based models and tuned multilayer perceptrons remain highly competitive, often dominating under inference-time or training-cost constraints. Overall, TabBioMed shows that biomedical tabular learning is strongly context-dependent, with optimal model choice depending on data regime, task type, and computational budget. We release TabBioMed with curated datasets and splits, preprocessing code, baselines, and results, providing a reproducible benchmark for practical model selection and future methods development in biomedical machine learning, available at https://github.com/AI-sandbox/TabBioMed.
zh_abstract: 机器学习的最新进展加速了生物医学预测，但对结构化生物医学数据的评估仍然零散，尤其是对于具有高维、大样本量、缺失值和类别不平衡的数据集。我们推出TabBioMed，这是一个大规模基准，包含94个经过整理的公共生物医学表格数据集，涵盖电子健康记录、药物发现、基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学、单细胞组学和系统生物学。TabBioMed通过标准化的、数据集感知的预处理和评估框架统一这些数据集，从而能够在分类、回归和多目标任务之间进行可重复比较。我们对23个模型进行了基准测试，涵盖经典基线、梯度提升树、神经表格架构和表格基础模型。基础模型在模型族层面表现出最强的预测性能。然而，它们的增益依赖于数据情形：基于树的模型和调优的多层感知机仍极具竞争力，在推理时间或训练成本约束下往往占优。总体而言，TabBioMed表明生物医学表格学习强烈依赖于具体情境，最优模型选择取决于数据情形、任务类型和计算预算。我们发布TabBioMed，包括经过整理的数据集和划分、预处理代码、基线和结果，为生物医学机器学习中的实际模型选择和未来方法开发提供可重复的基准，网址为 https://github.com/AI-sandbox/TabBioMed。

title: Grounding Radiology Reports in 3D Chest CT: Results of the ReXGrounding Challenge
zh_title: ReXGrounding挑战赛：3D胸部CT报告定位结果
summary: 首个将放射报告所见定位到3D胸部CT分割的MICCAI挑战赛，公布数据集与参赛结果。
key_points: 2,992例训练、300例测试含582条所见
48队760次提交，最佳Dice 0.375、命中率0.77
测试集由认证放射科医师完整标注
reason: 大规模公开数据集与留出测试基准，含专家标注，属重要档
abstract: Segmenting each reported finding in a radiology scan would allow findings to be measured and tracked over time and let AI systems generate reports that are verifiable, but so far AI models have performed poorly at this task. To advance this task, we organized the ReXGrounding Challenge at MICCAI 2026, the first challenge dedicated to it. Given a non-contrast chest CT scan and the set of findings from its report, participants trained models to produce the corresponding set of 3D segmentations. The challenge used 2,992 training and 200 validation scans from the ReXGroundingCT dataset, and evaluated methods on a held-out test set of 300 scans with 582 findings, exhaustively annotated by board-certified radiologists. In total, 48 teams from 15 countries made 760 submissions, and the best method reached a Dice of 0.375 and a hit rate of 0.77, matching agreement between two independent radiologist groups (Dice 0.32, hit rate 0.76, on a 50-scan subset). On the 100 scans of the pre-challenge benchmark, the winner reached a Dice of 0.390, against 0.285 for VoxTell, the best model before the challenge, which five of the six best teams fine-tuned. Non-focal findings remained far harder to segment than focal ones, instance F1 stayed below inter-reader agreement (0.34 vs. 0.47), and models sometimes segmented the right abnormality in the wrong location. Top methods thus match radiologist agreement in Dice, but non-focal findings, findings with multiple instances, and adherence to the anatomical location described in the text remain open problems.
zh_abstract: 在放射学扫描中分割每条报告的影像所见，将有助于对所见进行测量和随时间追踪，并使AI系统能够生成可验证的报告，但迄今为止AI模型在此任务上表现不佳。为推进该任务，我们在MICCAI 2026组织了ReXGrounding挑战赛，这是首个专门针对该任务的挑战赛。给定非增强胸部CT扫描及其报告中的一组所见，参赛者训练模型以生成对应的3D分割集合。该挑战赛使用来自ReXGroundingCT数据集的2,992例训练扫描和200例验证扫描，并在由300例扫描、582条所见组成的留出测试集上评估方法，该测试集由委员会认证的放射科医生进行了详尽标注。共有来自15个国家的48支队伍提交了760份结果，最佳方法达到Dice 0.375和命中率0.77，与两个独立放射科医生组之间的一致性相当（在50例扫描子集上Dice 0.32、命中率0.76）。在挑战赛前基准的100例扫描上，获胜者达到Dice 0.390，而挑战赛前最佳模型VoxTell为0.285，六支最佳队伍中有五支对其进行了微调。非局灶性所见的分割仍远比局灶性所见困难，实例F1仍低于阅片者间一致性（0.34对0.47），且模型有时将正确的异常分割到错误位置。因此，顶尖方法在Dice上已达到放射科医生间一致性，但非局灶性所见、具有多个实例的所见，以及对文本所述解剖位置的依从性仍是未解决的问题。

title: SWIMSS: An Open Multi-Center SwinUNETR Model for Multiple Sclerosis White Matter Lesion Segmentation
zh_title: SWIMSS：多中心MS白质病灶分割开放模型
summary: 基于SwinUNETR的SWIMSS模型在7个瑞士中心1385例多发性硬化患者数据上训练与测试，用于白质病灶分割。
key_points: 纳入7中心1385例纵向MRI数据
与UNETR、MSSegDiff及LST-AI比较
报告Dice相似系数及95%置信区间
reason: 多中心1385例、开放模型并对比多种基线，预印本中证据较强，属重要档。
abstract: Purpose: To develop and validate SWIMSS (SWInUNETR for Multiple Sclerosis white matter lesion Segmentation), a SwinUNETR-based deep learning (DL) model for reliable automated white matter (WM) lesion segmentation, in a large multicentric cohort of people with multiple sclerosis (pwMS). Methods: A real-world longitudinal dataset of 1,385 pwMS from seven Swiss clinical centers was used to train, validate, and test SWIMSS and two state-of-the-art DL architectures: UNETR and MSSegDiff. Inference results obtained with LST-AI were also compared. Preprocessed magnetization-prepared rapid acquisition gradient echo and fluid-attenuated inversion recovery MRI sequences, acquired with various MR systems and field strengths, served as model inputs. Model performance was evaluated using the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) with 95% confidence intervals (CI). Results: SWIMSS achieved the highest performance, with a DSC of 81.37 (95% CI: 80.63-82.11), outperforming UNETR (79.06; 95% CI: 78.33-79.79), MSSegDiff (75.70; 95% CI: 74.97-76.43), and LST-AI (63.19; 95% CI: 62.08-64.30). Normalized DSC followed a similar trend, with SWIMSS reaching 84.88. Lesion detection F1 achieved 81.14. Statistical analyses confirmed its superior performance (p < 0.001). Conclusion: SWIMSS achieved state-of-the-art performance for WM lesion segmentation. By making this model publicly available, we enable broader access to high-quality segmentation tools, allowing smaller centers, often lacking large annotated datasets or computational resources, to benefit from a model trained on a diverse, large-scale cohort. This promotes more equitable access to advanced imaging analysis and supports reproducibility and standardization in MS research.
zh_abstract: 【目的】开发并验证SWIMSS（SWInUNETR for Multiple Sclerosis white matter lesion Segmentation），这是一种基于SwinUNETR的深度学习（DL）模型，用于在大型多中心多发性硬化患者（pwMS）队列中实现可靠的自动化白质（WM）病变分割。【方法】使用来自瑞士七家临床中心的1,385例pwMS的真实世界纵向数据集，对SWIMSS及两种最先进的DL架构（UNETR和MSSegDiff）进行训练、验证和测试。还将使用LST-AI获得的推理结果进行了比较。以采用不同MR系统和场强采集的、经过预处理的磁化准备快速采集梯度回波（MP-RAGE）和液体衰减反转恢复（FLAIR）MRI序列作为模型输入。使用Dice相似系数（DSC）及95%置信区间（CI）评估模型性能。【结果】SWIMSS表现最佳，DSC为81.37（95% CI: 80.63-82.11），优于UNETR（79.06；95% CI: 78.33-79.79）、MSSegDiff（75.70；95% CI: 74.97-76.43）和LST-AI（63.19；95% CI: 62.08-64.30）。归一化DSC呈现相似趋势，SWIMSS达到84.88。病变检测F1为81.14。统计分析证实其性能优越（p < 0.001）。【结论】SWIMSS在白质病变分割方面达到了最先进的性能。通过公开该模型，我们使高质量分割工具能够更广泛地获取，让通常缺乏大型标注数据集或计算资源的较小中心也能受益于在多样、大型队列上训练的模型。这促进了先进影像分析的更公平可及性，并支持MS研究中的可重复性和标准化。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Benchmarking Uncertainty Quantification in Retinal Disease Screening
zh_title: 视网膜疾病筛查不确定性量化的基准评测
summary: 构建24.2万张眼底图、32个数据集的多疾病基准，评测六种不确定性量化策略与三种ViT配置。
key_points: 覆盖糖尿病视网膜病变、年龄相关黄斑变性、青光眼
评估判别力、概率校准、选择性预测与共形预测覆盖
未发现普遍最优的模型或不确定性量化策略
reason: 32个数据集24万张图的大规模多数据集外部评测基准，达重要档
abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for evaluating retinal AI systems beyond classification accuracy, yet it remains unclear whether existing UQ strategies generalize across diseases, model architectures, and reliability criteria. We introduce a large-scale, multi-disease benchmark comprising over $242,000$ fundus photographs from $32$ datasets covering diabetic retinopathy, age-related macular degeneration, and glaucoma. We evaluate six representative UQ strategies across three Vision Transformer configurations, assessing discrimination, probabilistic calibration, selective prediction, and conformal prediction-set coverage. Our findings reveal no universally superior model or UQ strategy: methods that improve reliability in one disease or architecture may underperform in another, while improvements in discrimination, calibration, and selective prediction do not necessarily align. Notably, computationally intensive methods do not consistently outperform simple confidence scores, and domain-specific foundation models and calibration-oriented loss functions do not guarantee greater reliability. In contrast, conformal prediction provides a complementary framework for achieving near-nominal marginal prediction-set coverage across diverse settings, subject to its statistical assumptions. These findings challenge universal UQ recommendations and highlight the need for disease-specific, model-specific, and multidimensional reliability evaluation before clinical deployment. We release standardized dataset splits, trained checkpoints, evaluation code, and an interactive research demonstration to support reproducible benchmarking.
zh_abstract: 可靠的不确定性量化（UQ）对于在分类准确率之外评估视网膜 AI 系统至关重要，但现有 UQ 策略是否能在不同疾病、模型架构和可靠性标准之间泛化仍不清楚。我们引入一个大规模、多疾病基准，包含来自 32 个数据集的超过 242,000 张眼底照片，覆盖糖尿病视网膜病变、年龄相关性黄斑变性和青光眼。我们在三种 Vision Transformer 配置上评估六种代表性 UQ 策略，考察判别力、概率校准、选择性预测和共形预测集覆盖率。我们的发现表明不存在普遍更优的模型或 UQ 策略：在一种疾病或架构中提高可靠性的方法，在另一种中可能表现较差，而判别力、校准和选择性预测方面的改善不一定彼此一致。值得注意的是，计算密集型方法并不始终优于简单的置信度分数，领域特定基础模型和面向校准的损失函数也不能保证更高可靠性。相比之下，共形预测提供了一种补充框架，可在多种设置下实现接近名义水平的边际预测集覆盖率，但以其统计假设为前提。这些发现挑战了通用的 UQ 建议，并强调在临床部署前需要进行疾病特定、模型特定和多维度的可靠性评估。我们发布了标准化数据集划分、训练检查点、评估代码和交互式研究演示，以支持可复现的基准测试。

title: ANCHOR: AI-NGS consensus hierarchy for optimized refinement of high-affinity binders from affinity maturation.
zh_title: ANCHOR：AI与NGS共识分层筛选高亲和力结合体
summary: 结合AI分类/回归模型与NGS共识序列，在Fyn SH2模型体系中从亲和力成熟文库中筛选高亲和力结合体。
key_points: 采用评分解耦的两阶段策略构建候选池

abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] Affinity maturation for the systematic discovery of high-affinity protein reagents remains a major challenge in display-based protein engineering, largely because phenotypic enrichment frequently fails to correlate with true binding affinity. To improve candidate identification, we developed ANCHOR, an artificial intelligence (AI) and next-generation sequencing (NGS) consensus hierarchy for optimized refinement that implements a score-decoupled, two-stage strategy. Enrichment-trained classifier and regression models are used to construct a candidate pool, from which group-specific consensus sequences are subsequently derived without ranking candidates solely by individual model scores. Using the phosphotyrosine-binding Fyn SH2 domain as a model system, the two models achieved strong performance on untouched independent test sets (classification area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) = 0.974; regression Pearson's r = 0.870). By leveraging a biopanning-guided filter, ANCHOR reduced the searchable sequence space by approximately four orders of magnitude while maintaining a ~90% overlap with exhaustive screening and retained 297 enrichment-predicted variants. These variants were grouped by residue identity at the least-conserved position (P4) and consensus sequences were derived within each group. Among the 16 evaluable consensus variants, 9 (56%) matched or exceeded the affinity of TrM, a previously established 100-fold-improved superbinder, with several showing a two-fold further improvement. Exploratory analyses using a structural proxy indicated robustness to parameter choices and a higher observed hit rate for ANCHOR than for the evaluated alternatives. Application to a public anti-HER2 scFv yeast-display NGS dataset demonstrated computational portability across datasets and library designs. Collectively, ANCHOR provides a practical framework for prioritizing affinity-maturation candidates from display-derived NGS data.

abstract: [Artificial organs] In recent years, there has been a notable surge in the ability of machines to perform complex and intelligent human-centered tasks, particularly within the domain of cardiovascular health. Rapid advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) algorithms reflect the considerable potential for such analyses to meaningfully extend into translational device development and clinical usage of medical devices, especially mechanical circulatory support (MCS) therapies. Here, we investigate and report the applications, limitations, and strategies in which AI is currently being employed in MCS and the potential opportunities of AI approaches to advance the field of MCS. To effectively assess the scope and impact of AI in MCS, we conducted a systematic literature review. A comprehensive search of 4 recognized research databases (PubMed, Google Scholar, Ovid MEDLINE, and ProQuest) was performed using this Boolean string: "(Artificial Intelligence) AND (AI) AND (Mechanical Circulatory Support) AND (MCS) NOT (Heart Transplant) NOT (Cardiogenic Shock) NOT (Critical Care)." Database search results were then screened by titles and abstracts, followed by full-text eligibility assessment and duplicate removal. Following these screening and eligibility steps, 30 of the 328 identified articles remained for inclusion. Most relevant publications covered two main subjects: the prediction and management of postoperative outcomes, and the development of personalized device-patient matching and timing. Across the reviewed studies, AI/ML models demonstrated promising performance in study-specific predictions of complications, recovery-related outcomes, and survival and were investigated as tools to support clinical decision-making. Barriers to broad implementation of AI include the necessity for sizable, high-quality datasets to achieve algorithm training benchmarks, the lack of organized and complete databases, such as INTERMACS, and limited computational resources. Emerging frontiers of MCS recognize the potential for AI and ML techniques to refine image recognition capabilities, diagnostic assessment, device placement, and post-implantation monitoring approaches in the future. abstract: AbstractIn the past year, the medical field's relationship to clinical AI has progressed from rapid and often speculative adoption toward evaluation of its impact on patient outcomes, clinical workflows, and society. Drawing from the Symposium on AI for Learning Health Systems (SAIL) Year in Review (May 2026), this Perspective examines six key areas that dominated the domain of clinical AI in the past year: clinical AI evaluation, workflow integration, direct-to-consumer applications, regulation and societal impacts, AI in medical education, and foundational advancements in technology. abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are used to explain clinical prediction models, on the promise that they can say what a model computes, find its faults and even reveal new knowledge in it. We tested the three promises where the answers could be checked. From the International Stroke Trial we trained four kinds of model (logistic regression, explainable boosting machine, gradient-boosted trees, neural network) for two outcomes on patients randomised earlier, planted one flaw in each of 24 copies (an under-predicted subgroup, a reversed risk factor or an implausible step) and mixed them with the 8 clean models. GPT-6 Astra audited each model three times, blind, through a tool that only returned the model's predictions; the judging rules were committed before any run and applied by program. Its surrogate models, with a median of 128 terms, reproduced the audited models' log-odds with a mean $R^2$ of 0.976 (0.959 for an additive surrogate of 42 terms fitted by an analyst). It found the planted flaw in 69 of 72 runs (96%; 95% CI 80% to 99%); a script written for the purpose found all 24. It also reported many more problems: 60% of 1,089 checkable reports failed the pre-specified check against the model's average behaviour; post hoc, most of these were real but small steps, and 15% of the checkable reports were not found in the model. Of 601 unexpected relationships it read out of the clean models, 11% held in patients randomised later (random pairs 6%; a regression scan's shorter list of its strongest candidates, 28%); after a check on the training data, 33% against 30%. With query access alone, an LLM can describe a black-box model faithfully and find nearly every planted flaw, as a purpose-written script also did; its reports of problems must be checked on the model and its discoveries on data.

abstract: [Journal of medical Internet research] Although a growing number of AI-based predictive models for discharge disposition in patients following primary total knee arthroplasty (TKA) have been constructed, their performance, quality, and applicability remain unclear. This study aimed to evaluate the performance, quality, and applicability of published AI-based predictive models for discharge disposition in patients following primary TKA. PubMed, Web of Science, Embase, the Cochrane Library, Scopus, China National Knowledge Infrastructure, Wanfang Database, China Science and Technology Journal Database, and SinoMed Database were searched from inception to May 26, 2025. abstract: [Expert opinion on drug metabolism & toxicology] Drug-drug interactions (DDIs) are a preventable cause of adverse drug events (ADEs), yet conventional interaction-checking tools are hampered by incomplete knowledge, poor concordance, and clinically unusable alert burdens. Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly utilized to strengthen multiple stages of the DDI pathway. This narrative review synthesizes literature identified through searches conducted between 15 July and 20 October 2026. It examines how machine learning (ML) predicts novel drug interactions from molecular structure and knowledge graphs; how natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs) identify and extract interactions from the literature, drug labels, and pharmacovigilance data; and how AI can make clinical decision support context-aware and support medication review. It also integrates mechanistic physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling and individualized patient-level risk prediction. Prediction models achieve impressive benchmark accuracy but frequently underperform in realistic, cold-start settings; LLMs detect interactions with high sensitivity but show poor severity calibration and persistent hallucination. The near-term value of AI lies less in autonomous prediction than in curating knowledge, personalizing alerts, and augmenting clinician judgment. Rigorous external validation, interpretability, and regulatory clarity are prerequisites for clinical adoption.

title: Accurate and interpretable protein complex stoichiometry prediction through agentic AI with StoiAgent
zh_title: StoiAgent智能体预测蛋白复合物化学计量比

abstract: Accurate protein complex structure modeling requires knowledge of complex stoichiometry, yet the copy numbers of individual subunits are often unknown. Consequently, predicting protein complex stoichiometry has emerged as a major challenge in recent years. Here, we present StoiAgent, a large language model (LLM)-powered AI agent that automates the retrieval and integration of sequence, structural, and literature evidence to predict stoichiometry while preserving interpretable reasoning traces (chain of thoughts) of its evidence assessment and ranking decision. An open-weight LLM model, Qwen3.6-27B, is used by StoiAgent as the LLM backbone to combine sequences, structural templates, AlphaFold3 structure predictions, and literature evidence, and perform stoichiometry candidate generation and ranking. On 56 CASP17 protein complex targets, it achieves top-1 accuracy of 75.0%, which represents a 23.2 percentage-point improvement over PreStoi with AlphaFold3 ranking (51.8%) and matches the top-1 accuracy of StoPred. Moreover, StoiAgent has a higher top-3 and top-5 accuracy than StoPred (85.7% versus 80.4% and 87.5% versus 85.7%, respectively). Furthermore, it outperforms general-purpose frontier LLMs, including ChatGPT and Gemini, in stoichiometry prediction. Case studies further illustrate how StoiAgent evaluates competing assembly hypotheses by integrating complementary evidence, with recorded reasoning traces documenting its decision-making process. Overall, StoiAgent demonstrates the potential of LLM-powered AI agents to improve protein complex stoichiometry prediction through the automated integration of diverse sources of evidence while providing interpretable explanations to guide downstream structure modeling.
zh_abstract: 准确的蛋白质复合物结构建模需要了解复合物化学计量比，然而单个亚基的拷贝数往往未知。因此，预测蛋白质复合物化学计量比近年来已成为一项重大挑战。在此，我们提出 StoiAgent，一种由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的 AI 智能体，它自动化检索并整合序列、结构和文献证据以预测化学计量比，同时保留其证据评估和排序决策的可解释推理轨迹（思维链）。StoiAgent 使用开放权重 LLM 模型 Qwen3.6-27B 作为 LLM 主干，以结合序列、结构模板、AlphaFold3 结构预测和文献证据，并执行化学计量比候选生成和排序。在56个 CASP17 蛋白质复合物靶标上，它达到75.0%的 top-1 准确率，相较采用 AlphaFold3 排序的 PreStoi（51.8%）提高23.2个百分点，并与 StoPred 的 top-1 准确率相当。此外，StoiAgent 的 top-3 和 top-5 准确率高于 StoPred（分别为85.7%对80.4%和87.5%对85.7%）。此外，在化学计量比预测方面，它优于包括 ChatGPT 和 Gemini 在内的通用前沿 LLM。案例研究进一步说明了 StoiAgent 如何通过整合互补证据来评估相互竞争的组装假设，并记录了推理轨迹以记载其决策过程。总体而言，StoiAgent 展示了由 LLM 驱动的 AI 智能体通过自动整合多种来源证据来改进蛋白质复合物化学计量比预测的潜力，同时提供可解释的解释以指导下游结构建模。

title: GenVinci reconstructs 3D molecular tissue scenes from histology to map senescence across aging and disease
zh_title: GenVinci从组织病理重建三维分子场景
summary: 预印本构建3亿细胞级空间组学语料ImageOmicsNet-300M，并提出从2D H&E重建3D组织场景的多模态基础模型。
key_points: 构建含3亿细胞与空间转录组谱的语料
从常规H&E零样本预测空间基因表达
映射8580万细胞的衰老相关状态
reason: 大规模数据与基础模型有亮点，但为未经同行评审预印本且公开性未述
abstract: Spatial omics has generated measurements at unprecedented scale, yet computational approaches remain largely confined to individual modalities and 2D representations. Here we assemble ImageOmicsNet-300M, a corpus of 300 million single-cell and spatial transcriptomic profiles, including 24.9 million H&E-predicted virtual spatial transcriptomics profiles, and 4,623 H&E sections. Of these H&E sections, we generated 1,782 from aging mouse organs and serially sectioned human skin spanning five decades, with matched spatial transcriptomics and snRNA-seq. Building on this resource, we develop GenVinci, a multimodal tissue foundation model that reconstructs 3D tissue scenes from routine 2D histology. GenVinci predicts spatial gene expression from H&E with zero-shot generalization and maps senescence-associated states across 85.8 million cells, revealing cell-type-specific patterns and disease-associated remodeling. Integration with human genetics implicates suprabasal keratinocytes in atopic dermatitis and keratinocyte carcinomas, linked to higher and lower p16 and p21 expression, respectively. These findings establish GenVinci as a framework mapping senescence in 3D across scales.
zh_abstract: 空间组学已以前所未有的规模产生测量数据，然而计算方法在很大程度上仍局限于单一模态和二维表示。在此，我们构建了 ImageOmicsNet-300M，这是一个包含 3 亿个单细胞和空间转录组图谱的语料库，其中包括 2490 万个由 H&E 预测的虚拟空间转录组图谱，以及 4623 张 H&E 切片。在这些 H&E 切片中，我们从衰老小鼠器官以及跨越五个十年（50 年）连续切片的人皮肤中生成了 1782 张，并配有匹配的空间转录组学和 snRNA-seq。基于这一资源，我们开发了 GenVinci，这是一种多模态组织基础模型，可从常规二维组织学重建三维组织结构场景。GenVinci 能够以零样本泛化从 H&E 预测空间基因表达，并在 8580 万个细胞中绘制衰老相关状态，揭示细胞类型特异性模式和疾病相关重塑。与人类遗传学的整合表明，基底层上角质形成细胞（suprabasal keratinocytes）与特应性皮炎和角质形成细胞癌有关，分别与较高和较低的 p16 和 p21 表达相关。这些发现确立了 GenVinci 作为一个跨尺度三维绘制衰老图谱的框架。

title: BiomedCAT: Biomedical Context Analysis Tool for Supporting Mechanistic Hypothesis Generation via User-defined Contextual Subgraph Extraction
zh_title: BiomedCAT：将科研幻灯片转为知识图谱子图
summary: 开源工作流用视觉语言模型与小型智能体将生物医学幻灯片转为RTX-KG2c子图，辅助机制假说生成。
key_points: 小型视觉语言模型描述幻灯片，40亿参数智能体映射Biolink类别
实体存在性校验去除虚构实体，标识符仅检索不生成
合成基准上本地智能体准确率0.71（517条非歧义样本）
reason: 预印本新方法且开源，有专家审核基准，但证据仅限合成基准，属值得一看档
abstract: Researchers formulate mechanistic hypotheses in slides and figures long before they write them as text, yet knowledge-graph (KG) tools expect a query in the vocabulary of the graph. We present BiomedCAT, an open-source workflow that turns biomedical slides into a subgraph of the RTX-KG2c knowledge graph shaped by the user's research profile, on a laptop and without sending the documents out. A small vision-language model describes each slide; a 4-billion-parameter agent types the terms into the classes of the Biolink model; an existence gate removes invented entities; identifiers are retrieved from Translator services or from a local table and selected, never generated, by a judge model; and a profile-weighted two-hop expansion builds the context graph. On a synthetic Biolink typing benchmark whose labels were audited by an expert, the local agent reaches 0.71 accuracy on 517 non-ambiguous mentions, 4 points below Claude Opus 5 (0.75), level with DeepSeek-V4-Flash (0.69) and above open-weight models of 24 and 31 billion parameters; the audit also showed that 55% of the generated labels were wrong or ambiguous. On expert-annotated slide decks, the reading stage recovers 81 to 94% of the explicit terms of the English deck, less on French decks, and linking assigns the expert identifier to 65% of the found terms online and 26% in the fully local mode. A one-slide run takes 33 to 42 minutes, with peaks of 9.8~GB of system RAM above idle and 5.3~GB of GPU memory. In a facioscapulohumeral muscular dystrophy (FSHD) case, three slides that each draw one pathway from DUX4 at a different biological scale give graphs that overlap by 7 to 15% of their nodes, each recovering its own pathway's expected nodes, and expose sourced paths from DUX4, such as a DUX4--HMGB1 interaction from IntAct. Of 21 compounds tested in FSHD, seven, including every agent that targets DUX4, are absent from RTX-KG2c, which bounds what a graph-based approach can propose. BiomedCAT lets a researcher set a working hypothesis against curated knowledge, with every edge traceable to its source.
zh_abstract: 研究人员在幻灯片和图表中形成机制假设，远早于将其写成文本，然而知识图谱（KG）工具期望以图自身的词表进行查询。我们提出 BiomedCAT，一种开源工作流，可在笔记本电脑上、无需将文档发送出去，将生物医学幻灯片转换为由用户研究画像塑造的 RTX-KG2c 知识图谱子图。一个小型视觉语言模型描述每张幻灯片；一个40亿参数的智能体将术语归入 Biolink 模型的类别；一个存在性门控移除虚构实体；标识符从 Translator 服务或本地表中检索，并由一个评判模型选择、而非生成；再通过按画像加权的两跳扩展构建上下文图。在一个合成 Biolink 类型标注基准上（其标签经专家审核），该本地智能体在517个非歧义提及上达到0.71准确率，比 Claude Opus 5（0.75）低4个百分点，与 DeepSeek-V4-Flash（0.69）持平，并高于240亿和310亿参数的开权重模型；审核还显示，55%的生成标签错误或存在歧义。在专家标注的幻灯片组上，读取阶段可召回英文幻灯片81%至94%的明确术语，在法文幻灯片上较低；链接阶段在线为65%的已发现术语分配专家标识符，在完全本地模式下为26%。运行一张幻灯片耗时33至42分钟，系统 RAM 峰值较空闲状态高出9.8 GB，GPU 显存峰值高出5.3 GB。在一个面肩肱型肌营养不良症（FSHD）案例中，三张幻灯片分别从DUX4出发、在不同生物学尺度上描绘一条通路，所得图节点重叠7%至15%，每张图各自恢复其通路的预期节点，并展示出来自DUX4的有来源路径，例如来自IntAct的DUX4--HMGB1相互作用。在FSHD中测试的21种化合物里，有七种（包括所有靶向DUX4的药物）未出现在RTX-KG2c中，这限定了基于图谱的方法能够提出的内容。BiomedCAT使研究人员能够将工作假设与经整理的知识对照，且每条边都可追溯到其来源。

title: Reference-Guided Data Curation for 3D Medical Vision-Language Pretraining
zh_title: 参考集引导的3D医学视觉语言预训练数据筛选
summary: 提出离线、免训练的参考集引导数据筛选方法，用于提升3D医学视觉语言模型预训练数据质量。
key_points: 用小型高质量参考集为各模态提取质量信号
经秩聚合融合为单一排序指导样本选择
在3.5万例3D腹部CT与5.8万例胸片对上验证

abstract: Training 3D vision-language models (VLMs) on large medical imaging datasets collected across institutions is constrained by data quality. Vast, uncurated pools of image-report pairs are characterized by redundancy, class imbalance, and cross-institutional heterogeneity. We address this challenge of data curation for improving 3D VLM pretraining by proposing an offline, training-free, reference-guided data curation recipe. Our approach leverages a small, high-quality reference set to independently extract quality signals for each modality of a large, uncurated pool and merges them through a rank-aggregation step into a single ranking that guides sample selection. We validate this method on datasets comprising 35k 3D abdominal CT volume-report pairs from two institutions and 58k 2D chest X-ray image-report pairs. On 3D CT, using our reference-guided data curation strategy, our curated model matches the zero-shot disease classification performance of a state-of-the-art baseline (Merlin) while using $3.3\times$ less training data and a reference set of 5k samples. On 2D chest X-rays, our method yields a curated model that matches or exceeds the zero-shot disease classification performance of a model trained on the full pool while using up to $10\times$ less training data and a reference set of only 74 samples. Ablations show that the selection is stable under resampling of the reference, that smaller reference sets still outperform random sampling, and that label rebalancing does not improve performance. To support reproducibility, we release our code.
zh_abstract: 在跨机构收集的大型医学影像数据集上训练三维视觉语言模型（VLM）受到数据质量的制约。庞大、未经整理的图像-报告对池具有冗余、类别不平衡和跨机构异质性等特征。我们通过提出一种离线、无需训练、参考集引导的数据整理方案，来应对改进三维 VLM 预训练所面临的数据整理挑战。我们的方法利用一个小型高质量参考集，针对大型未整理池中的每个模态独立提取质量信号，并通过秩聚合步骤将其合并为单一排序，以指导样本选择。我们在包含来自两个机构的35k个三维腹部 CT 容积-报告对和58k个二维胸部 X 射线图像-报告对的数据集上验证了该方法。在三维 CT 上，使用我们的参考集引导数据整理策略，我们经整理的模型在零样本疾病分类性能上匹配最先进基线（Merlin），同时使用的训练数据少3.3倍，并使用5k个样本的参考集。在二维胸部 X 射线上，我们的方法得到的经整理模型在零样本疾病分类性能上匹配或超过在全池上训练的模型，同时使用的训练数据最多少10倍，且参考集仅74个样本。消融实验表明，在参考集重采样下选择是稳定的，较小的参考集仍优于随机采样，且标签重平衡并未提高性能。为支持可复现性，我们公开了代码。

title: DRAFT: graph-recurrent learning of dynamic gene regulatory networks along single-cell multi-omics trajectories
zh_title: DRAFT：从单细胞多组学轨迹推断动态基因调控网络
summary: 提出结合图注意力与循环时序记忆的深度学习框架，从时间分辨单细胞多组学数据推断动态基因调控网络。
key_points: 模拟数据上准确性与时间平滑性优于现有方法
小鼠重编程与果蝇精子发生中结果获ChIP-seq等支持
可由网络结构识别活性早于转录峰的调控因子

abstract: Single-cell multi-omics data offer an opportunity to resolve how gene regulatory networks (GRNs) are rewired during cell-fate transitions, but most existing methods infer static snapshots, ignore temporal dependencies or assume linear regulation. Here we present DRAFT, a deep learning framework that combines graph attention with recurrent temporal memory to infer dynamic GRNs from time-resolved single-cell multi-omics data. On simulated data, DRAFT outperforms existing methods in accuracy and temporal smoothness. In mouse cellular reprogramming and Drosophila adult spermatogenesis, it recovers interactions supported by independent ChIP-seq, perturbation and Hi-C data, together with known stage-specific regulators. By inferring regulatory activity from dynamic network structure rather than expression alone, DRAFT identifies regulators whose activity precedes their transcriptional peak, including the candidate early germline regulator Mondo. Germline-specific Mondo knockdown alters germline stem cell number and expression of the predicted targets kuz and mamo. DRAFT also enables nonlinear alignment of co-developing lineages and reveals stage-specific cell-cell communication.
zh_abstract: 单细胞多组学数据为解析基因调控网络（gene regulatory networks, GRNs）在细胞命运转变过程中如何重连提供了机会，但大多数现有方法推断静态快照、忽略时间依赖性，或假设线性调控。在此，我们提出 DRAFT，一种深度学习框架，它将图注意力与循环时间记忆相结合，从时间分辨的单细胞多组学数据中推断动态 GRNs。在模拟数据上，DRAFT 在准确性和时间平滑性方面优于现有方法。在小鼠细胞重编程和果蝇成虫精子发生中，它恢复了由独立 ChIP-seq、扰动和 Hi-C 数据支持的相互作用，以及已知的阶段特异性调控因子。通过从动态网络结构而非仅从表达推断调控活性，DRAFT 识别出活性先于其转录峰值的调控因子，包括候选早期生殖系调控因子 Mondo。生殖系特异性 Mondo 敲低改变了生殖系干细胞数量以及预测靶标 kuz 和 mamo 的表达。DRAFT 还能实现共同发育谱系的非线性对齐，并揭示阶段特异性的细胞间通讯。

title: Image-Condition-Controlled Diffusion Network with Large-Scale CT Pretraining for CT-Free Attenuation Correction in Dynamic Cardiac PET

summary: 提出LUCID框架，将1万例胸部CT学到的解剖先验迁移到动态心脏82Rb PET的μ图合成，无需配对PET/CT。
key_points: 用CT-RATE的1万例胸部CT预训练
以扩散模型合成PET衰减图

abstract: Positron emission tomography (PET) provides quantitative information on myocardial perfusion. In dynamic PET, tracer kinetics are tracked through a series of reconstructed time frames. Reliable attenuation correction is essential for accurate measurements. Clinical attenuation maps ($μ$-maps) are typically derived from computed tomography (CT), which adds radiation exposure and may introduce PET-CT misregistration due to respiratory and cardiac motion. Moreover, supervised CT-free methods rely on paired non-attenuation-corrected (NAC) PET and CT data, which are scarce, whereas large-scale unpaired CT data are more readily available. To address these challenges, we propose Large-scale Unpaired CT-Informed Diffusion (LUCID), a framework that transfers anatomical priors learned from 10,000 chest CT volumes in the public CT-RATE dataset to $μ$-map synthesis for dynamic cardiac $^{82}$Rb PET. First, a convolutional neural network (CNN) predicts an initial $μ$-map from each NAC PET frame. Second, the CT-pretrained diffusion backbone refines a low-noise perturbation of the CNN prediction through a single denoising step, conditioned on the corresponding NAC PET frame via ControlNet. Finally, frame-wise predictions are averaged voxel-wise to obtain the final $μ$-map. We further introduce the voxel-wise temporal standard deviation (TSD) to quantify inter-frame variability without requiring a reference $μ$-map. We evaluated LUCID on an in-house dataset of 102 patients and found that it achieved the best quantitative accuracy while maintaining competitive inter-frame consistency. Ablation studies showed that refinement with a diffusion backbone pretrained on in-house CT data from the training patients was less accurate than the CNN prediction alone, highlighting the importance of large-scale CT pretraining.
zh_abstract: 正电子发射断层扫描（PET）可提供心肌灌注的定量信息。在动态 PET 中，通过一系列重建的时间帧追踪示踪剂动力学。可靠的衰减校正是准确测量所必需的。临床衰减图（μ-map）通常由计算机断层扫描（CT）导出，这会增加辐射暴露，并可能因呼吸和心脏运动引入 PET-CT 配准误差。此外，有监督的无 CT 方法依赖于配对的不进行衰减校正（NAC）的 PET 与 CT 数据，而这类数据稀缺；相比之下，大规模未配对 CT 数据更易获得。为应对这些挑战，我们提出大规模无配对 CT 信息引导扩散（Large-scale Unpaired CT-Informed Diffusion, LUCID）框架，该框架将从公共 CT-RATE 数据集中 10,000 个胸部 CT 体积学到的解剖先验迁移到动态心脏 $^{82}$Rb PET 的 μ-map 合成中。首先，卷积神经网络（CNN）从每个 NAC PET 帧预测初始 μ-map。其次，经 CT 预训练的扩散骨干网络通过单步去噪，对 CNN 预测的低噪声扰动进行细化，并通过 ControlNet 以相应的 NAC PET 帧为条件。最后，将逐帧预测按体素平均，得到最终 μ-map。我们进一步引入体素级时间标准差（TSD），以在不需要参考 μ-map 的情况下量化帧间变异性。我们在包含 102 名患者的内部数据集上评估 LUCID，发现其达到最佳的定量准确性，同时保持有竞争力的帧间一致性。消融研究表明，使用来自训练患者的内部 CT 数据预训练的扩散骨干网络进行细化，其准确性低于单独的 CNN 预测，这突显了大规模 CT 预训练的重要性。

abstract: Deep learning systems grade prostate biopsies at the level of pathologists, but most report a grade without the glandular architecture that justifies it. This work presents a grading system built on a sparse code over the tokens of a pathology foundation model. A sparse autoencoder pretrained on biopsies is aligned with multi-reader annotations, so that 69 of its 2048 features are named after Gleason morphologies such as cribriform glands, cords, and comedonecrosis. The same code feeds a grading network, which reads all features to predict Gleason patterns and the Grade Group, while morphology maps read directly from the named features. We evaluate the system on five public datasets that include needle biopsies, tissue-microarray cores, multi-reader annotations, and three scanners. The morphology maps remain stable across alignment runs and, without retraining, detect cribriform glands in external biopsies (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, AUROC, 0.849) and pattern 5 in unseen cores when evaluated by up to six pathologists (AUROC 0.846 to 0.919). In an independent biopsy cohort, Grade Group agreement with three pathologists on Leica scans is close to their agreement with each other. Removing the named features reduces the corresponding Gleason pattern predictions by 49% to 98%, with effects larger than those from 20 activity-matched random feature removals. These results show that a shared sparse representation can support competitive Gleason grading while providing named morphological evidence that transfers across datasets and whose contribution to grading can be measured directly.
zh_abstract: 深度学习系统在前列腺活检分级方面达到病理学家的水平，但大多数系统仅报告分级，而不提供支持该分级的腺体结构。本研究提出了一种基于病理基础模型token的稀疏编码构建的分级系统。一个在活检图像上预训练的稀疏自编码器与多阅片者标注对齐，使其2048个特征中的69个以Gleason形态命名，如筛状腺体、条索和粉刺样坏死。同一稀疏编码输入一个分级网络，该网络读取所有特征以预测Gleason模式和Grade Group，而形态学图则直接读取这些命名特征。我们在五个公共数据集上评估该系统，这些数据集包括穿刺活检、组织微阵列核心、多阅片者标注和三种扫描仪。形态学图在不同对齐运行间保持稳定，且无需重新训练，即可在外部活检中检测筛状腺体（受试者工作特征曲线下面积，AUROC，0.849），并在由最多六名病理学家评估的未见过的组织微阵列核心中检测模式5（AUROC 0.846至0.919）。在一个独立活检队列中，Leica扫描图像上与三名病理学家的Grade Group一致性接近这些病理学家彼此之间的一致性。移除这些命名特征使相应的Gleason模式预测降低49%至98%，其效应大于20次活动匹配的随机特征移除所产生的效应。这些结果表明，共享稀疏表示能够支持具有竞争力的Gleason分级，同时提供可跨数据集迁移的命名形态学证据，并且其对分级的贡献可直接测量。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Peking University Health Science Center; conditions: Chest Pain, Unstable Angina (UA), ST Elevation Myocardial Infarction (STEMI), Non-ST Elevation Myocardial Infarction (nSTEMI), Aortic Dissection; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 120; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This study will assess whether reports generated by ZERO, a mobile system for interpreting electrocardiogram (ECG) images, improve clinicians' ability to identify causes of chest pain compared with interpretation without AI assistance. A total of 120 licensed cardiology clinicians will be randomly assigned in a 1:1 ratio to ZERO-assisted or unassisted interpretation. Each clinician will assess 30 ECG cases during a single session lasting up to 60 minutes. The cases will include five examples from each of six diagnostic categories: unstable angina, non-ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction, ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction, aortic dissection, pulmonary embolism, and other diagnoses. No case or patient will be repeated within or across clinicians. For each case, clinicians will first review the ECG and submit an initial diagnosis that cannot subsequently be changed. Clinicians in the ZERO-assisted group will then view a fixed report generated before clinician randomization. Clinicians in the unassisted group will review the ECG again without an AI report. All clinicians will then submit a final diagnosis. Diagnostic performance will be assessed against clinical reference diagnoses established before the interpretation task and withheld from participating clinicians. The study will use ECG cases from completed clinical encounters and will not affect patient care. The hypothesis is that ZERO-assisted clinicians will achieve higher final diagnostic accuracy than unassisted clinicians.

abstract: [Technology and health care : official journal of the European Society for Engineering and Medicine] BackgroundTracking, classifying, and segmenting cell images are critical clinical tasks essential in diagnosing various diseases such as leukemia and in performing blood counts. While deep neural architectures are preferred for these tasks, the presence of noise in images, overlapping cells, and indistinct cell boundaries make it a challenging endeavor.ObjectiveIn this article, an attention mechanism based on U-Net has been developed for cell segmentation. abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Ambu A/S; conditions: Bronchoscopy; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 153; status: RECRUITING] This clinical investigation evaluates the Ambu Broncho AI Navigator, an investigational software system designed to provide real-time navigational support during bronchoscopy. The system uses artificial intelligence to identify and display airway anatomy during procedures and to help bronchoscopists track which airway segments have been examined. The study is conducted at Odense University Hospital and consists of two phases. In Phase 2a, experienced bronchoscopists use the system during routine bronchoscopies to evaluate and optimize technical settings and usability. For this phase 45 patients will be enrolled. In Phase 2b, bronchoscopies are randomized (1:1) to be performed with or without the Broncho AI Navigator to evaluate the impact of AI guidance on procedural performance. For this phase 108 patients will be enrolled. Adult patients undergoing elective bronchoscopy are enrolled, while the primary study subjects are the bronchoscopists performing the procedures. The study evaluates whether use of the Broncho AI Navigator improves bronchoscopy performance by increasing diagnostic completeness, improving structured progression through the bronchial tree, and reducing procedure time. The findings will support further development and future validation of the Broncho AI Navigator in clinical practice.

abstract: [Computer methods in biomechanics and biomedical engineering] Accurate recognition of gait phases from surface electromyography (sEMG) signals is essential for intelligent prosthetics, exoskeletons, and rehabilitation. This study proposes a residual convolutional Kolmogorov-Arnold network (RCKAN) that integrates convolutional feature encoding, ridge-regularized nonlinear mapping, and residual learning for five-phase gait classification. Experimental results on data from 40 healthy subjects demonstrate that RCKAN achieves state-of-the-art accuracy of 95.52%, surpassing conventional machine learning and advanced deep learning architectures. The model maintains strong performance in transitional phases such as heel strike and toe-off, confirming its robustness and potential for real-time gait analysis and assistive control applications.
zh_abstract: [Computer methods in biomechanics and biomedical engineering] 从表面肌电（sEMG）信号中准确识别步态相位对于智能假肢、外骨骼和康复至关重要。本研究提出一种残差卷积 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（RCKAN），它整合了卷积特征编码、岭正则化非线性映射和残差学习，用于五相步态分类。基于 40 名健康受试者数据的实验结果表明，RCKAN 达到 95.52% 的当前最佳准确率，超越了传统机器学习和先进深度学习架构。该模型在足跟着地和足趾离地等过渡阶段保持强劲性能，证实了其稳健性以及在实时步态分析和辅助控制应用中的潜力。

abstract: [Journal of general internal medicine] As artificial intelligence (AI) promises diagnostic precision approaching human expertise, medicine faces a profound paradox: expanding technological capabilities risk eroding the human encounter between caregiver and patient. The Age of Reason in medicine has privileged quantifiable, systematized knowledge validated through randomized controlled trials, yet this epistemological dominance threatens to hollow out medicine's humanistic core. While algorithms excel at pattern recognition and prediction, they cannot grapple with ambiguity, uncertainty, or the irreducible complexity of human suffering. AI deployment risks creating an "AI trust gap" and automation bias among clinicians. Narrative medicine offers an essential counterweight, defining illness as a meaningful disruption of a person's life story rather than merely a departure from physiological norms. Empirical evidence demonstrates that narrative medicine training improves empathy, communication skills, and clinical outcomes. This perspective argues for mandatory, longitudinal narrative medicine curricula and institutional reforms that recognize humanistic practice as a core professional competency, ensuring AI serves rather than obscures medicine's irreducible humanity.
zh_abstract: [Journal of general internal medicine] 当人工智能（AI）有望实现接近人类专业水平的诊断精度时，医学面临一个深刻悖论：不断扩展的技术能力存在侵蚀照护者与患者之间人际相遇的风险。医学中的理性时代赋予了可量化、系统化并经随机对照试验验证的知识以优先地位，然而这种认识论上的主导地位有可能掏空医学的人文核心。尽管算法擅长模式识别和预测，但它们无法应对模糊性、不确定性或人类痛苦不可化约的复杂性。AI 部署存在造成临床医生中“AI 信任鸿沟”和自动化偏倚的风险。叙事医学提供了一种必要的制衡，它将疾病定义为对个人生命故事的有意义打断，而不仅仅是偏离生理常模。实证证据表明，叙事医学培训可改善共情、沟通技巧和临床结局。本观点主张设置强制性的、纵向贯穿的叙事医学课程，并进行制度改革，将人文实践视为核心专业能力，以确保 AI 服务于而非遮蔽医学不可化约的人性。

title: Beyond animal testing: integrated AI-PBPK-MPS framework for human-relevant toxicology.
zh_title: AI-PBPK-器官芯片整合框架用于人体相关毒理
summary: 综述新方法学进展，讨论AI预测毒理、PBPK与微生理系统整合用于人体相关安全性评估及FDA相关计划。
key_points: 涵盖图神经网络、深度学习、可解释AI与IVIVE建模
提及FDA预测毒理路线图、ISTAND MIDD与CiPA
为综述性文章，未提供原始实验数据
reason: 综述类文章按上限6分，内容为领域概述、无新数据，属增量档
abstract: [Critical reviews in toxicology] NAMs are revolutionizing safety assessment and bridging the substantial disconnect between traditional animal toxicology studies and human exposure within the pharmaceutical industry. AI predictive toxicology uses graph neural networks, deep learning, explainable AI, PBPK, and IVIVE modeling for human-dose predictions, and micro-physiological and organ-on-a-chip systems that replicate specific physiological states. The development of NAMs has been applied to FDA initiatives, such as the Predictive Toxicology Roadmap, ISTAND MIDD, and CiPA, to demonstrate how integrated NAM systems optimized at early drug development stages provide valuable information on mechanistic toxicities related to humans and accelerate drug development. AI-QSAR models, PBPK simulations, and organ-on-a-chip technologies are increasingly integrated with discovery and early-stage preclinical workflows in different sectors. Standardization and reproducibility across platforms, transparency of AI models, multiomics integration, and global regulator convergence are required to improve the power of AI. This review is the first to provide a unified mechanistic synthesis of all three pillars of NAMs, AI-based predictive toxicology, PBPK-IVIVE modeling, and microphysiological systems (MPS), while earlier reviews covered them independently. We suggest a cyclical NAM ecosystem in which AI predictions seek translation to human pharmacokinetics, with iterative mechanistic validation via MPS, solving current challenges of translation from animals to humans. This review is distinct from others in that it presents NAM technologies as an integrated, human-relevant system rather than disparate technologies, and thus offers regulators a roadmap.
zh_abstract: [Critical reviews in toxicology] 新方法（NAMs）正在彻底改变安全性评估，并在制药行业中弥合传统动物毒理学研究与人类暴露之间存在的显著脱节。AI 预测毒理学利用图神经网络、深度学习、可解释 AI、PBPK 和 IVIVE 建模进行人体剂量预测，并利用可复制特定生理状态的微生理系统和器官芯片系统。NAMs 的发展已应用于 FDA 倡议，如 Predictive Toxicology Roadmap、ISTAND MIDD 和 CiPA，以展示在早期药物开发阶段优化的集成 NAMs 系统如何提供与人类相关的机制毒性方面的有价值信息并加速药物开发。AI-QSAR 模型、PBPK 模拟和器官芯片技术正日益在不同领域的发现和早期临床前工作流程中整合。需要跨平台的标准化和可重复性、AI 模型的透明度、多组学整合以及全球监管趋同，以提高 AI 的效力。本综述首次对 NAMs 的三大支柱——基于 AI 的预测毒理学、PBPK-IVIVE 建模和微生理系统（MPS）——提供统一的机制性综合，而此前的综述分别独立涵盖它们。我们提出一个循环式 NAM 生态系统，其中 AI 预测寻求向人体药代动力学的转化，并通过 MPS 进行迭代机制验证，解决当前从动物到人类转化的挑战。本综述与其他综述的不同之处在于，它将 NAM 技术呈现为一个集成的、与人类相关的系统，而不是分散的技术，从而为监管机构提供路线图。
